notes: Character swap lane: MiniMax H3 Ref2VA int8 plus the Akatz character-swap LoRA (mirrored at manifoldgenstatic models/h3-character-swap, pinned to HF revision 62407e0 and sha256). Request contract: task-less input {video_url, image_urls[1-3], prompt, steps, turbo, easycache, megapixels, seed, _output_upload_url, _output_public_url}; the server app (H3_SWAP_RUNPOD_ENDPOINT_ID, H3_SWAP_WORKERS_MAX) fans a source out as <=5 s clips. Weights are fetched by 48 ranged connections at cold start; only the Ref2VA transformer, text encoder, video and audio VAEs are installed (no FL2VA). See workers/h3-swap/README.md.
